title: Mom is missing
simplified_paragraphs: 春节到了， 女儿和女婿开车带妈妈从广东回湖北过年。 路上， 他们在加油站停车加油。
妈妈想上厕所， 没有告诉他们就下车了。 女儿在车里睡觉， 女婿加完油没有看妈妈在不在车上， 就开车走了。
车开了一公里， 女婿问： “ 妈妈， 你想吃东西吗？ ” 可是没有人说话。 这时候他们才发现妈妈不在车里。 两个人都很着急， 可是手机没有信号， 他们不知道怎么办。
幸好路上有工作人员发现了他们。 工作人员开车找到妈妈， 安全地把妈妈送回女儿女婿那里。 一家人终于又在一起了。
traditional_paragraphs: 春節到了， 女兒和女婿開車帶媽媽從廣東回湖北過年。 路上， 他們在加油站停車加油。
媽媽想上廁所， 沒有告訴他們就下車了。 女兒在車裡睡覺， 女婿加完油沒有看媽媽在不在車上， 就開車走了。
車開了一公里， 女婿問： “ 媽媽， 你想吃東西嗎？ ” 可是沒有人說話。 這時候他們才發現媽媽不在車裡。 兩個人都很著急， 可是手機沒有信號， 他們不知道怎麼辦。
幸好路上有工作人員發現了他們。 工作人員開車找到媽媽， 安全地把媽媽送回女兒女婿那裏。 一家人終於又在一起了。
pinyin_paragraphs: Chūn jié dào le，  nǚ ér hé nǚ xu kāi chē dài mā ma cóng Guǎng dōng huí Hú běi guò nián。  lù shàng，  tā men zài jiā yóu zhàn tíng chē jiā yóu。
mā ma xiǎng shàng cè suǒ，  méi yǒu gào su tā men jiù xià chē le。  nǚ ér zài chē lǐ shuì jiào，  nǚ xu jiā wán yóu méi yǒu kàn mā ma zài bù zài chē shàng，  jiù kāi chē zǒu le。

chē kāi le yī gōng lǐ，  nǚ xu wèn：“  mā ma，  nǐ xiǎng chī dōng xi ma？”  kě shì méi yǒu rén shuō huà。  zhè shí hou tā men cái fā xiàn mā ma bù zài chē lǐ。  liǎng gè rén dōu hěn zháo jí，  kě shì shǒu jī méi yǒu xìn hào，  tā men bù zhī dào zěn me bàn。
xìng hǎo lù shàng yǒu gōng zuò rén yuán fā xiàn le tā men。  gōng zuò rén yuán kāi chē zhǎo dào mā ma，  ān quán de bǎ mā ma sòng huí nǚ ér nǚ xu nà lǐ。  yī jiā rén zhōng yú yòu zài yī qǐ le。
english_paragraphs: The Spring Festival had arrived. A daughter and her husband drove her mother from Guangdong back to Hubei to celebrate the New Year. On the way, they stopped at a gas station to fill up the car.

Mom wanted to go to the toilet and got off the bus without telling them. The daughter was sleeping in the car, and the son-in-law drove off after refueling the car without checking if his mother was in the car.

After driving one kilometer, the son-in-law asked, "Mom, do you want to eat?" But no one said anything. That's when they realized their mother wasn't in the car. Both of them were very anxious, but there was no signal on their mobile phones and they didn't know what to do.
Fortunately, a staff member spotted them on the road. The staff drove to find the mother and safely sent her back to her daughter and son-in-law. The family is finally together again.
english_full:
The Spring Festival had arrived. A daughter and her husband drove her mother from Guangdong back to Hubei to celebrate the New Year. On the way, they stopped at a gas station to fill up the car.

Mom wanted to go to the toilet and got off the bus without telling them. The daughter was sleeping in the car, and the son-in-law drove off after refueling the car without checking if his mother was in the car.

After driving one kilometer, the son-in-law asked, "Mom, do you want to eat?" But no one said anything. That's when they realized their mother wasn't in the car. Both of them were very anxious, but there was no signal on their mobile phones and they didn't know what to do.

Fortunately, a staff member spotted them on the road. The staff drove to find the mother and safely sent her back to her daughter and son-in-law. The family is finally together again.
